response_text: Open the store. No farmer starves on my land.
reaction_text: Bless you! We'll work those fields till they shine.

response_text: Plant the east field first. Its first sacks are yours.
reaction_text: A promise, then. I'll hold you to it, ruler.

response_text: Everyone gets the same ration. No exceptions.
reaction_text: Fair, I suppose... but fair doesn't fill a bowl.

response_text: Complain again and you'll dig ditches instead.
reaction_text: ...Yes, ruler. As you say, ruler.

response_text: Down tools until the noon bell. Rest well.
reaction_text: You're a good sort! We'll be back twice as sharp.

response_text: Hot stew for every builder tonight, on the crown.
reaction_text: Stew! Now that's worth swinging a hammer for.

response_text: The kingdom needs walls, not naps. Back to work.
reaction_text: Back to work... right. Hope the walls love you back.

response_text: Double rations tonight. An army marches on its belly.
reaction_text: Ha! Now that's a ruler worth marching for!

response_text: Take the watchtower and you'll each be paid in gold.
reaction_text: Gold when the tower falls. We'll remember that, ruler.

response_text: Your pay is serving the crown. Dismissed.
reaction_text: Serving the crown. Right. Tastes a lot like porridge.

response_text: Grumble again and you'll guard the pig pens.
reaction_text: N-no grumbling, ruler. Not a word.

response_text: Take what your families need. Warm homes, strong arms.
reaction_text: Thank you! The little ones will sleep warm tonight.

response_text: Haul one extra load each, and those logs are yours.
reaction_text: A fair trade. Axes up, friends, we've logs to earn!

response_text: Every log belongs to the kingdom. Taking one is theft.
reaction_text: Theft. Of logs we cut ourselves. Well.

response_text: Shore it up with timber before anyone digs.
reaction_text: Oh, thank you! I'll sleep tonight, truly.

response_text: Rocks always groan. Keep digging.
reaction_text: If you say so, ruler... I'll keep one eye on the ceiling.

response_text: Show me. I'll walk the rock face with you myself.
reaction_text: You'd come down here? With us? Then it can't be so bad.

response_text: The cart is yours. {rival} can carry sacks on foot.
reaction_text: Ha! Justice at last. That'll wipe the smirk off.

response_text: I'll have a second cart made. No more quarrels.
reaction_text: Two carts? Well... that does solve it, I suppose.

response_text: Sort it out yourselves, or you both haul at night.
reaction_text: Night hauling? Fine. We'll sort it. Somehow.

response_text: Take forty stone. A sound forge, a sound kingdom.
reaction_text: Now we're talking! Your soldiers will feel the difference.

response_text: Twenty now. The rest when the walls are done.
reaction_text: Half a forge it is. I'll hold you to the other half.

response_text: Patch it with clay. Stone goes to the walls first.
reaction_text: Clay. On a forge. I'll do what I can, but don't expect miracles.

response_text: I'll drill them myself at dawn.
reaction_text: At dawn, then! They'll stand taller with you beside them.

response_text: Feed them well first. Strength before drills.
reaction_text: Full bellies, steady arms. Good thinking, ruler.

response_text: Punish the slowest in front of the others.
reaction_text: As you command. They'll fear the yard... and you.

response_text: Light every oven. A feast for the whole kingdom!
reaction_text: A feast! I'll have the bread rising within the hour!

response_text: A modest supper, and keep the stores full.
reaction_text: Modest it is. Warm and filling, nothing wasted.

response_text: Feasts are for victories. We celebrate when we win.
reaction_text: As you wish. I'll save the honey cakes for that day.

response_text: Open court at the keep. Anyone may speak freely.
reaction_text: Wisely chosen. Words spoken aloud do less harm than whispers.

response_text: Fear keeps them working. My methods stay.
reaction_text: Then let us hope the beams hold, ruler.

response_text: Give me the names of the whisperers, elder.
reaction_text: ...I am old, ruler, and my memory fails me. Forgive me.

response_text: A promise is a promise. Take your sacks.
reaction_text: You kept your word! I'll tell the whole valley.

response_text: Not yet. Next harvest, on my word.
reaction_text: Next harvest... your word is wearing thin, ruler.

response_text: The kingdom needs that grain more than you do.
reaction_text: So that's what a ruler's word is worth. Noted.

response_text: Pay them in full. They earned every coin.
reaction_text: Gold! Three cheers for the crown!

response_text: Half now. The treasury is thin.
reaction_text: Half's better than nothing... just about.

response_text: Victory is its own reward, soldier.
reaction_text: Victory doesn't buy boots, ruler. The squad won't forget this.
